title: Diagnostics contract
description: Language-neutral crash/error telemetry shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. diagnosticsReport mirrors the Firestore `diagnosticsReports/{reportId}` document: admin-only read, writes exclusively via the PUBLIC diagnostics.submitReport callable (anonymous reports allowed — sign-in failures must be reportable; App Check applies in production). Privacy guarantees enforced server-side: metadata is sanitized (auth tokens, credentials, cookies, coordinates, and stack-trace-like keys stripped; only bounded scalar values stored), stack traces and raw headers are never stored, and safeMessage must already be privacy-safe on the client. Reports carry a SHA-256-based dedup fingerprint (numbers/UUIDs normalized out of the message) and are deleted after 90 days by the monthly scheduled cleanup. Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

submitDiagnosticsReportRequest.description: Input for diagnostics.submitReport. safeMessage must be privacy-safe (no tokens, no personal data, no coordinates); the backend additionally sanitizes metadata and never stores stack traces.

metadata.description: Optional context. Sanitized server-side: max 20 keys, scalar values only (strings truncated to 500 chars), token/credential/coordinate/stack-like keys stripped.

fingerprint.description: Dedup/grouping fingerprint over the stable attributes.

diagnosticsReport.description: Firestore `diagnosticsReports/{reportId}`. Admin-only read; no client writes.

userId.description: Null for anonymous reports (unauthenticated submission is allowed).

metadata.description: Sanitized metadata; null when nothing safe remained.
